notes:
Summary: Small regional apparel + accessories brand. ~3k SKUs (mix of variants). Primary goal: reduce product-support volume by embedding a product Q&A widget on PDP and power a fast sample-based search. Wants catalog enrichment (auto-product descriptions + attribute extraction) to fix crawl / SEO issues.

Customer quotes / tone: 'We get 30-40 product questions/day, and during promotions that spikes — need something we can plug in fast.' 'Prefer pay-as-you-go; cannot commit to big contracts upfront.'

Technical: prefers hosted API (self-serve). Low-latency important for on-page Q&A (target p50 < 300ms for single-turn). Search/embeddings use OK with 50-200ms vector lookups; willing to accept slightly higher latencies for background enrichment jobs. Catalog ingestion: CSV -> enrichment -> embeddings; expects help with best practices for batching and chunking product descriptions.

Commercial: very cost sensitive. Expected monthly spend initially low (a few hundred dollars) but large spikes during promos (Black Friday-style summer sale). Interested in Redwood's burst handling and paging guidance.

Operational asks: example ingestion scripts, recommended batching/quantization settings for embeddings, clear docs on streaming + fallback to smaller models during quota pressure. Open to SOC2/audit logging options but will not require on-prem.

Internal contacts: Elena Cruz (Founder / CTO) — elena@threadedlark.co (primary), Jordan Meyers (Head of Ops) — jordan@threadedlark.co.
requirements_summary: Hosted API self-serve lead. Use-cases: product Q&A widget (low-latency), periodic catalog enrichment jobs (auto descriptions + attribute extraction), embeddings for site search and reranking. Catalog: ~3k SKUs. Traffic: normal low volume with bursty spikes during promos (10x). Cost sensitivity => wants per-token clarity + burst safeguards. Security: cloud-only; wants audit logs and SOC2 assurances.
